facts.text: The Nonprofit Leadership Alliance, formerly American Humanics, was founded on Missouri Valley College's campus by former college president H. Roe Bartle.

sources.title: MVC Nonprofit Leadership Alliance Wins Nonprofit Campus Of The Year - Missouri Valley University
sources.quote: The Nonprofit Leadership Alliance, formerly American Humanics, was founded on the MVC campus by H. Roe Bartle. Bartle was a businessman, philanthropist, and Boy Scout executive who served as president of Missouri Valley College from 1948-1950.

concerns: In 2026, Missouri Valley College announced its transition to Missouri Valley University.
